questions.q: I can ___ the teacher, but I can't see her.
questions.e: 这里说能听见老师，can 后接动词原形，不加 s、ing 或 to。

questions.q: For ___, we can use this program at school.
questions.e: for example 整体引出例子，空前已有 for，无须再写。

questions.q: For more ___ about this program, call our company.
questions.e: 这里要说更多资料。information 以 -tion 结尾，是名词。

questions.q: It's a ___ place to work.
questions.e: place 前要用形容词。这里选带 -able 的词，副词放不进去。

questions.q: I ___ found the right place.
questions.e: finally 表示终于，修饰 found。形容词不能修饰这个动作。

questions.q: Our team is really ___ this week.
questions.e: active 以 -ive 结尾，是形容词。actively 是副词。

questions.q: Can I hear your answer ___? (Use one word for 'one more time'.)
questions.e: again 放在宾语 your answer 后面，修饰 hear，表示再听一次。不要把它插在动词和宾语之间。

questions.q: I ___ like this place. (Use one word for 'very much' that ends in -ly.)
questions.e: really 是副词，可以放在 like 前表示确实很喜欢。very 不能直接放在 like 前。

questions.zh: 我们在这家公司工作很努力。
a: We work hard at this company.
At this company, we work hard.
questions.e: hard 本身就能作副词，放在 work 后表示努力。hardly 表示几乎不，意思差得很远。
friendly 虽然以 -ly 结尾，却是形容词。它可以跟在 is 后描述老师，也可以直接修饰 teacher。
find 后接要找的事物。right 在这里是形容词，要放在名词 place 前。

questions.a: In this case, we can use the old system.
questions.e: in this case 表示在这种情况下，句首别漏掉 this。old 是形容词，放在 system 前，整块 the old system 作 use 的宾语。

questions.q: My first class ___ at nine.
questions.e: class 是单数，用 is 作谓语。being 不能独立作谓语。

questions.q: I ___ always on time.
questions.e: on time 说明状态，需要 be 作谓语。主语是 I，所以用 am。

questions.q: At night, ___ goes to work.
questions.e: goes 要配单数主语。him 是宾格，不能独立作主语。

questions.q: We move ___ in the office every day.
questions.e: move 后直接接宾语 the table。he 是主格，不能作宾语。

questions.q: The students ___ at school during the week.
questions.e: use 后直接接宾语 the system，再交代地点和时间。

questions.q: We talk at school ___.
questions.e: every day 表示每天，直接放在地点后，day 用单数，不加介词。

questions.q: The students ___ very happy at school. (Use 'be' in the present.)
questions.e: very happy 描述学生的状态，句子要补 be 作谓语。students 是复数，因此用 are。

questions.q: I play the piano at home ___. (Put 'night at' in the right order.)
questions.e: at night 是固定搭配，放在地点 at home 后面。night at 把介词和名词的顺序颠倒了。

questions.zh: 我每天都在学校看那本书。
a: I read that book at school every day.
Every day, I read that book at school.
questions.e: 先说 I read that book，再补地点和时间。要突出每天，也可以把 every day 放在整句开头。

a: Our teacher is in the office.
questions.e: in the office 只交代地点，句子还需要 is 作谓语。第二种写法里的 's 是 is 的缩写。

questions.a: We ask questions in class every day.
questions.zh: 我们每天都在课堂上提问。
questions.e: We ask questions 是主干。排好主语、动词和宾语，再接地点 in class 和时间 every day。

questions.a: I always get up at the same time.
questions.e: always 表示总是，放在实义动词 get 前。get up 是起床，at the same time 交代时间，别漏掉 at 或 the。

questions.q: I feel very ___ now. I need to sit down.
questions.e: feel 在这里是系动词，tired 描述人的状态，tiredly 是副词。

questions.q: It gets very ___ at night.
questions.e: gets 表示变得，后接形容词 cold。副词不能表示变成的状态。

questions.q: Is that a bag? It looks ___ a book.
questions.e: 像某物用 look like 加名词。nice 后不能直接接名词。

questions.q: Please show ___ before the meeting.
questions.e: show 后先放人 us，再放物 the report。we 是主格。

questions.q: We can make ___.
questions.e: make 的物在前，受益人用 for 引出。人放前面则要用宾格 her。

questions.q: What ___ at the meeting?
questions.e: What 是主语，happen 不接宾语，也不用被动形式。

questions.q: I get ___ before a test. (Use the -ed form of 'worry'.)
questions.e: get 在这里表示变得，后面用形容词 worried 描述主语。worry 加 -ed 时，先把 y 改成 i。

questions.q: She can lend the book ___ me. (Use one word to show who will get the book.)
questions.e: lend 后先说借出的东西 the book，再用 to 引出收到书的人。for 表示为某人做事，不能代替这里的 to。

a: Please bring the map to me.
questions.e: bring 可以直接接 me 和 the map。先说地图，就要在 me 前加 to，不能把两个宾语直接倒过来。

a: We'll hold a meeting next week.
We will hold a meeting next week.
Next week, we'll hold a meeting.
questions.e: hold a meeting 表示召开会议，hold 是谓语动词的一部分，a meeting 是宾语。next week 前不用加 in。

questions.a: Please get me a cup of tea.
questions.e: get 后先交代给谁，再交代拿什么。先说 a cup of tea 时，要用 for me 引出受益人。
can't 表示不能，漏写 n't 就变成肯定句。believe 后直接接宾语 it，无须加 in。

questions.q: My mother ___ young, and she works at a school.
questions.e: young 描述状态，前面用 is。后半句的 works 已能作谓语。

questions.q: I ___ money at home.
questions.e: keep 直接作谓语。主语是 I，用原形，前面不加 am。

questions.q: The children ___ this story.
questions.e: children 是复数，know 用原形直接作谓语，前面不加 are。

questions.q: ___ the money under the table or in the bag?
questions.e: money 不可数，配 is。问钱在哪里，要把 is 提到主语前。

questions.q: Are you from this area? Yes, ___.
questions.e: 回答时用 I am。肯定简答的 am 不能缩写，也不用疑问语序。

questions.q: This is ___ about a young doctor.
questions.e: is 后用名词短语说明这是什么。a 后接单数，true 修饰 story。

questions.q: In fact, I ___ late for class. (Use 'be' and 'not'.)
questions.e: be late for class 表示上课迟到。主语是 I，要用 am，否定词 not 放在 am 后。

questions.q: Our teacher ___ us after class. (Use 'help' in the present.)
questions.e: our teacher 是单数，help 要加 s。helps 已经是谓语，前面再加 is 就错了。

a: We always help her during the week.
During the week, we always help her.
questions.e: help 已经表达动作，可以直接作谓语，不加 are。always 放在 help 前，表示每次都这样。

questions.zh: 她和我来自同一个小镇。
a: She and I are from the same small town.
She and I come from the same small town.
questions.e: she and I 指两个人，用 are from。也可以用 come from，come 已作谓语，别再加 are。

questions.a: This area is very quiet at night.
questions.e: this area 是单数主语，is 作谓语，very quiet 描述这一带。直接把 quiet 接在主语后会漏掉谓语。

questions.a: My mother tells us a story every night.
questions.e: my mother 是单数，听写时别漏掉 tells 的 s。tells 已经是谓语，前面不加 is。后面先说听故事的人，再说故事。

questions.q: We need ___ the report before lunch.
questions.e: 说我们需要做某事，用 need 加 to 和动词原形。

questions.q: They practice ___ English at work.
questions.e: practice 后接动词的 -ing 形式，表示练习某项活动。

questions.q: Our first meeting ___ at nine every Monday.
questions.e: meeting 是单数，经常发生的事用一般现在时，写 starts。

questions.q: She ___ a different book for each class.
questions.e: she 是第三人称单数，have 的三单形式是 has，不能直接加 s。

questions.q: The office is far from home, ___.
questions.e: so 接出结果。两边都有主谓，只用逗号会把两个完整句子粘在一起。

questions.q: ___ We have no meetings today.
questions.e: 第一句缺 is 就没有谓语。两句都完整时，可以用句号分开。

questions.q: We want ___ a table for dinner. (Use 'book'.)
questions.e: book 在这里是预订。want 后接 to 加动词原形，不能直接把 book 放在 want 后。

questions.q: He ___ his children in the park every day. (Use 'watch'.)
questions.e: every day 表示日常习惯。主语 he 是三单，watch 以 ch 结尾，要加 -es。

a: I like to write at home.
questions.e: enjoy 后接 writing，不能接 to write。like 后两种形式都可以。at home 说明写作的地点。

questions.zh: 她有一份新工作，所以她今天很忙。
a: She has a new job, so she's busy today.
She has a new job, so she is busy today.
questions.e: she 后的 have 要变成 has。前后各有主语和谓语，用逗号加 so 连接，说明后一句是结果。

questions.a: This company sends us a report every week.
questions.zh: 这家公司每周都给我们发一份报告。
questions.e: this company 是单数主语，send 要加 s。动词后依次放收件人 us 和报告 a report，时间放句末。

questions.a: The room is small, but we can use it.
questions.e: 两边都有主语和谓语。听清表示转折的 but，写在逗号后，不能让逗号单独连接两个句子。
